root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 5. අත්තකාම වර්ගය

48. වෙදබ්භ ජාතකය

Msdiv 48“යමෙක් අනුපායයෙන් අභිවෘද්ධිය කැමති වේද, හෙතෙම වැනසේ. චේතිය නම් රටවැසි චෞරයෝ (වෛදර්භ නම් මන්ත්‍රය නිසා) වේදබ්භ නම්වූ බ්‍රාහ්මණයා නැසූහ. ඒ සියල්ලෝද වයසනයට පැමිණියාහුයි.”

වෙදබ්බ ජාතකං අට්ඨමං.

AP de Zoysa edition.

suttaplex.blurb: “Misguided effort.”—This story was told by the Master while at Jetavana, about a self-willed Brother. Said the Master to that Brother, “This is not the first time, Brother, that you have been self-willed; you were of just the same disposition in bygone times also ; and therefore it was that, as you would not follow the advice of the wise and good, you came to be cut in two by a sharp sword and were flung on the highway; and you were the sole cause why a thousand men met their end.” And so saying, he told this story of the past.
